long_biography.plain_text:
Stephen Riady was born in Jakarta and sent to school in Singapore at ten. While studying business administration at the University of Southern California, he spent holidays learning his father's businesses in Jakarta and made his first million at 22. He later earned an MBA from Golden Gate University.

After university, his father asked him to spearhead Lippo's overseas expansion from Hong Kong. Riady spent fifteen years building the group's Northeast Asian presence before settling in Singapore and shifting from short-term property investment towards long-term ownership and development. He became OUE's executive chairman in 2010 and group chief executive a decade later. He also established the Stephen Riady Group of Foundations, which supports education, health, humanitarian work and environmental conservation.
long_biography.html:
Stephen Riady was born in Jakarta and sent to school in Singapore at ten. While studying business administration at the University of Southern California, he spent holidays learning his father's businesses in Jakarta and made his first million at 22. He later earned an MBA from Golden Gate University.

After university, his father asked him to spearhead Lippo's overseas expansion from Hong Kong. Riady spent fifteen years building the group's Northeast Asian presence before settling in Singapore and shifting from short-term property investment towards long-term ownership and development. He became OUE's executive chairman in 2010 and group chief executive a decade later. He also established the Stephen Riady Group of Foundations, which supports education, health, humanitarian work and environmental conservation.
